resources.string: 1–2 real actions a day, you confirm each

When on, Sol plans one or two different actions a day at random times inside your waking hours: a small swap within your limits, the daily check-in, a suggested dApp or SKR staking. When one is due you get a notification with the details; tapping it opens the review and your wallet app asks you to approve. Sol never signs for you.

Turn on the Season autopilot? You will get up to the chosen number of notifications a day. Swaps use real funds on Solana mainnet and still need your approval in the wallet each time. Pause or stop it at any time.
Seeker Season points are decided by Solana Mobile, not by this app. The autopilot only suggests normal, varied use; nothing here guarantees points or rewards.

Sign one Approve in your wallet and the app\'s agent key may spend up to that allowance of one token for small swaps without asking each time. The swap output goes straight to your wallet.

⚠ Real funds on Solana mainnet. The agent key lives on this phone (encrypted with the Android Keystore) and could be compromised: whoever has it can move up to the remaining allowance anywhere. Its actions are signed by the agent key, not your wallet or Seed Vault, so Seeker Season may NOT count them. Revoke at any time.
